name: 97914 · Ontario, OR
findings: ZIP 97914 (Ontario) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97914 (Ontario) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
68% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97914 (Ontario) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
